default.name: Default Hunter
default.description: Standard balanced hunter profile utilizing default combat and gathering behavior.

knight.name: Knight (Melee Tank)
knight.description: Uses heavy armor and a shield. Relies on circle-strafing, block counters, and high-knockback parries.

archer.name: Archer (Ranged Support)
archer.description: High-mobility ranged fighter. Maintains distance (8-15m) and shoots predictive arrow/crossbow shots.

saboteur.name: Saboteur (Tactician)
saboteur.description: Utility planner. Throws slowness and harming potions, places cobwebs, and lights fires using flint & steel.
